import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, reverseIndex;
        Edge(int t, int c, int r) {
            to = t;
            capacity = c;
            reverseIndex = r;
        }
    }

    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int MAX_NODES = 210;

    static List<Edge>[] adj = new List[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] level = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] progress = new int[MAX_NODES];

    static void insertEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        adj[u].add(new Edge(v, cap, adj[v].size()));
        adj[v].add(new Edge(u, 0, adj[u].size() - 1));
    }

    static void computeLevels(int source) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        level[source] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int pushFlow(int node, int sink, int bottleneck) {
        if (node == sink) return bottleneck;
        for (; progress[node] < adj[node].size(); ++progress[node]) {
            Edge e = adj[node].get(progress[node]);
            if (e.capacity > 0 && level[node] < level[e.to]) {
                int pushed = pushFlow(e.to, sink, Math.min(bottleneck, e.capacity));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.capacity -= pushed;
                    adj[e.to].get(e.reverseIndex).capacity += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int computeMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (true) {
            computeLevels(source);
            if (level[sink] < 0) break;
            Arrays.fill(progress, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = pushFlow(source, sink, INF)) > 0) {
                totalFlow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    static final int[][] MOVES = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};

    static int size, steps, sourceNode, sinkNode;
    static int[][] capacities = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] science = new int[15][15];
    static int[][][] environment = new int[65][15][15];
    static boolean[][] explored = new boolean[15][15];
    static boolean[][][][][] connectivity = new boolean[65][15][15][15][15];

    static int encode(int x, int y, int type) {
        return (x-1)*size + y + type*size*size;
    }

    static void explore(int originX, int originY, int curX, int curY, int depth) {
        explored[curX][curY] = true;
        connectivity[depth][originX][originY][curX][curY] = true;
        if (depth >= steps || environment[depth][curX][curY] != 0) return;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = curX + MOVES[d][0], ny = curY + MOVES[d][1];
            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > size || ny > size) continue;
            if (explored[nx][ny] || environment[depth][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
            explore(originX, originY, nx, ny, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void initialize() {
        for (int t = 1; t <= steps; ++t) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= size; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= size; ++y) {
                    if (environment[t-1][x][y] != 0) {
                        environment[t][x][y] = environment[t-1][x][y];
                    } else {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = x + MOVES[d][0], ny = y + MOVES[d][1];
                            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > size || ny > size) continue;
                            if (environment[t-1][nx][ny] == 2) {
                                environment[t][x][y] = 2;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j) {
                if (science[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int x = 1; x <= size; ++x)
                        for (int y = 1; y <= size; ++y)
                            explored[x][y] = false;
                    explore(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int t = 1; t <= steps; ++t) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= size; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= size; ++y) {
                    for (int xx = 1; xx <= size; ++xx) {
                        for (int yy = 1; yy <= size; ++yy) {
                            connectivity[t][x][y][xx][yy] |= connectivity[t-1][x][y][xx][yy];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        size = sc.nextInt();
        steps = sc.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j) {
                char c = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) science[i][j] = c - '0';
                else if (c == 'Y') environment[0][i][j] = 1;
                else if (c == 'Z') environment[0][i][j] = 2;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j) {
                char c = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) capacities[i][j] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        
        sourceNode = size * size * 2;
        sinkNode = sourceNode - 1;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; ++i) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        initialize();
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; ++j) {
                if (science[i][j] != 0) insertEdge(sourceNode, encode(i,j,0), science[i][j]);
                if (capacities[i][j] != 0) insertEdge(encode(i,j,1), sinkNode, capacities[i][j]);
            }
        }
        for (int x = 1; x <= size; ++x) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= size; ++y) {
                for (int xx = 1; xx <= size; ++xx) {
                    for (int yy = 1; yy <= size; ++yy) {
                        if (science[x][y] != 0 && capacities[xx][yy] != 0 && connectivity[steps][x][y][xx][yy]) {
                            insertEdge(encode(x,y,0), encode(xx,yy,1), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(computeMaxFlow(sourceNode, sinkNode));
    }
}
